title: Agent Frontmatter CI Schema
description: CI-time schema for the in-memory agent index sync_agents.py builds from every agent's full frontmatter under .agent/agents/**/*.md. Not a runtime artifact — nothing named agent_registry.json is written to disk. sync_agents.py hard-fails (sys.exit(1)) if any agent fails this check, and feeds the validated in-memory list into ARCHITECTURE.md's auto-generated Agents table. mcp-llm-broker's main.go does not read this file or any generated manifest — loadAgentList() scans .agent/agents/**/*.md directly at request time (see tasks/2026-07-25-mcp-llm-broker-call-agent-drops-management-tier-agents.md for why an intermediate compiled-manifest design was tried and then removed as unnecessary machinery). Each entry carries whatever fields that agent's frontmatter declares (model/tier, domains, skills, hierarchy, ...), not a fixed subset — only name/description are contractually required here.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when sync_agents.py ran this validation.

agents.description: One entry per agent actually synced to .claude/agents/ for this profile — never includes profile-excluded agents. Each entry is that agent's full YAML frontmatter, unmodified, plus the two required fields below.

name.description: Agent identifier — matches the frontmatter name: field and the .md filename stem.

description.description: One-line focus summary shown to the calling LLM in call_agent's tool description, and used as ARCHITECTURE.md's Focus column (first sentence). Required — an agent with no description cannot be usefully selected by name or documented.
